$schema.description: Optional editor schema reference. The scanner does not fetch this value.

exclude.description: Directory exclusion globs relative to the configuration file's directory. !pattern reinclusion is unsupported; negative extglobs such as !(keep) are allowed.

ignorePackages.description: Package names or globs to omit from comparisons. !pattern reinclusion is unsupported; negative extglobs are allowed.

patterns.description: The scanner also validates balanced delimiters, a maximum nesting depth of 8 and a combined expansion budget of 4096 before matching.
